Good day SEABOURN SOJOURN Staff, 

 

We are looking forward to attending your good vessel during your call at Santa Cruz de Tenerife Port next 24TH March 2025 (08:00-23:00LT)

Berth assigned for this Port Call will be the same as last 12th March: Muelle Sur, 2nd alignment

 

These are the pre-arrival docs and info required by local Authorities that we need 96 hours before your arrival, of course the sooner the better:

 

1.          ETA Santa Cruz de Tenerife (regular updates requested, including 96, 48, 24, 12 hrs)

2.          ETD Santa Cruz de Tenerife

3.          Planned OPS at Tenerife: (scope of works if any)

4.          Drafts upon arrival

5.          Last port of call before Santa Cruz de Tenerife 

6.          Next port of call after Santa Cruz de Tenerife

7.          Itinerary which must includes ports, dates , ETA and ETD.

8.          Arrival and departure IMO Crew List in PDF format duly signed & stamped ( to be sent 96 hous min. before arrival date)

9.          Arrival and departure IMO Passengers List in PDF format duly signed and stamped ( to be sent 96 hours min. before arrival date)

10.       Arrival and departure Excel format crew list (attached example of filling in)(pls do not change the formats and fill in all columns highlighted in blue

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

12.       Crew and passenger list nationality breakdown in PDF format duly signed & stamped

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

20.       Copy of the Register Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

22.       Copy of the International Tonnage Certificate (ITC)

23.       Copy of the Inventory of Hazardous Materials (IHM) Certificate (required by EU Decree 1257/2013 for sea-going ships of more than 500 GT)

24.       Last PARIS MOU inspection (date and port)

25.       Ballast record book scan copy (including last deballast/ballast, place and date in it)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

27.       Maritime Declaration of Health (attached form of filling in) 

28.       Mosquitos Report (attached form of filling in)

29.       Vessels contact numbers (Cell, Inmarsat, Fax, etc..)

 

 

CREW:            Passport copies and full flight itineraries for all on-signing and/or off-signing crew for immigration purposes to make the arrangements needed.

Only Exit visas for off-signing crew can be arranged, documents need to be received at least 72 working hours in advance, from Monday to Friday, from 09:00-13:00 (visas will not be issued after this time)

Visas requested on Thursday / Friday will be appointed for the following week. 

Documents needed for the exit visa are Passport copy, Seaman’s book copy and Flight ticket with valid locator along with the Schengen Form attached filled up by the crew member.

                       Please find attached the crew movements instructions sheet will all relevant information concerning crew. Please, contact our Crew Dpt: crewlpa@canarship.com <mailto:crewlpa@canarship.com>

Do not hesitate to contact us for any need.

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

28.       Mosquitos Report (attached form of filling in)

I'll create a comprehensive prompt with clear guidelines, examples, and explanations of edge cases to help the model make accurate classifications.", "next_tool_name": "finish", "next_tool_args": {"prompt": "# Email Classification: IN_SCOPE vs. OUT_OF_SCOPE

You are tasked with analyzing emails to determine whether they should be classified as IN_SCOPE or OUT_OF_SCOPE for internal processing. This classification helps route emails to appropriate teams and systems.

## Input
You will receive an email with its subject line and body content.

## Output Requirements
For each email, provide:
1. A classification_label: either "IN_SCOPE" or "OUT_OF_SCOPE"
2. A confidence_score between 0 and 1 (where 1 is highest confidence)
3. A classification_rationale explaining your decision (2-3 sentences)

## Classification Guidelines

### OUT_OF_SCOPE Indicators:
- External vendor/supplier communications not part of established internal processes
- External recruitment agency communications
- Emails with "[EXTERNAL]" in subject lines or non-company domains in sender addresses
- System-generated messages (delivery failures, bounce notifications, quarantine notices)
- Communications requiring specialized handling (visa applications, procurement)
- Out-of-office auto-replies or marketing communications
- External port/travel agency communications requiring routing to vendor management
- Security concerns (suspicious attachments, phishing attempts)

### IN_SCOPE Indicators:
- Internal communications between company departments
- Emails using official company domains (@seabourn.com, @hollandamerica.com, @hagroup.com)
- Legitimate business communications regarding core operations (crew scheduling, staffing)
- Internal HR and employee communications, including contracts and assignments
- Communications between internal departments and their contracted service providers as part of established operational processes

## Important Edge Cases
- Even if external vendors are mentioned, communications between internal departments about legitimate operational matters should be classified as IN_SCOPE.
- Employee contract communications and crew assignments should generally be IN_SCOPE unless they involve external recruitment agencies.
- When in doubt about whether vendor communication is part of established operations, default to OUT_OF_SCOPE.

## Example Format
```
{
  "classification_label": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
  "confidence_score": 0.95,
  "classification_rationale": "External vendor communication from port agency regarding crew logistics and travel arrangements, with clear external domain indicators and warning banners."
}
```

Analyze both the subject line and body content carefully before making your classification decision."}}

Good day SEABOURN SOJOURN Staff, 

 

We are looking forward to attending your good vessel during your call at Santa Cruz de Tenerife Port next 24TH March 2025 (08:00-23:00LT)

Berth assigned for this Port Call will be the same as last 12th March: Muelle Sur, 2nd alignment

 

These are the pre-arrival docs and info required by local Authorities that we need 96 hours before your arrival, of course the sooner the better:

 

1.          ETA Santa Cruz de Tenerife (regular updates requested, including 96, 48, 24, 12 hrs)

2.          ETD Santa Cruz de Tenerife

3.          Planned OPS at Tenerife: (scope of works if any)

4.          Drafts upon arrival

5.          Last port of call before Santa Cruz de Tenerife 

6.          Next port of call after Santa Cruz de Tenerife

7.          Itinerary which must includes ports, dates , ETA and ETD.

8.          Arrival and departure IMO Crew List in PDF format duly signed & stamped ( to be sent 96 hous min. before arrival date)

9.          Arrival and departure IMO Passengers List in PDF format duly signed and stamped ( to be sent 96 hours min. before arrival date)

10.       Arrival and departure Excel format crew list (attached example of filling in)(pls do not change the formats and fill in all columns highlighted in blue

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

12.       Crew and passenger list nationality breakdown in PDF format duly signed & stamped

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

20.       Copy of the Register Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

22.       Copy of the International Tonnage Certificate (ITC)

23.       Copy of the Inventory of Hazardous Materials (IHM) Certificate (required by EU Decree 1257/2013 for sea-going ships of more than 500 GT)

24.       Last PARIS MOU inspection (date and port)

25.       Ballast record book scan copy (including last deballast/ballast, place and date in it)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

27.       Maritime Declaration of Health (attached form of filling in) 

28.       Mosquitos Report (attached form of filling in)

29.       Vessels contact numbers (Cell, Inmarsat, Fax, etc..)

 

 

CREW:            Passport copies and full flight itineraries for all on-signing and/or off-signing crew for immigration purposes to make the arrangements needed.

Only Exit visas for off-signing crew can be arranged, documents need to be received at least 72 working hours in advance, from Monday to Friday, from 09:00-13:00 (visas will not be issued after this time)

Visas requested on Thursday / Friday will be appointed for the following week. 

Documents needed for the exit visa are Passport copy, Seaman’s book copy and Flight ticket with valid locator along with the Schengen Form attached filled up by the crew member.

                       Please find attached the crew movements instructions sheet will all relevant information concerning crew. Please, contact our Crew Dpt: crewlpa@canarship.com <mailto:crewlpa@canarship.com> 

 

Please take note that for any crew/guest need (transfers, taxis, shuttle bus, meet & greet, accommodations, special assistance) you must contact our CREW DPT (crewlpa@canarship.com <mailto:crewlpa@canarship.com>   (+34 680846413 (duty phone 24/7) + operationstnf@canarship.com <mailto:operationstnf@canarship.com>  in copy

 

Do not hesitate to contact us for any need.

 

Many thanks to confirm safe receipt of this email.

 

 

Saludos/ Best Regards

Good day SEABOURN SOJOURN Staff, 

 

We are looking forward to attending your good vessel during your call at Santa Cruz de Tenerife Port next 24TH March 2025 (08:00-23:00LT)

Berth assigned for this Port Call will be the same as last 12th March: Muelle Sur, 2nd alignment

 

These are the pre-arrival docs and info required by local Authorities that we need 96 hours before your arrival, of course the sooner the better:

 

1.          ETA Santa Cruz de Tenerife (regular updates requested, including 96, 48, 24, 12 hrs)

2.          ETD Santa Cruz de Tenerife

3.          Planned OPS at Tenerife: (scope of works if any)

4.          Drafts upon arrival

5.          Last port of call before Santa Cruz de Tenerife 

6.          Next port of call after Santa Cruz de Tenerife

7.          Itinerary which must includes ports, dates , ETA and ETD.

8.          Arrival and departure IMO Crew List in PDF format duly signed & stamped ( to be sent 96 hous min. before arrival date)

9.          Arrival and departure IMO Passengers List in PDF format duly signed and stamped ( to be sent 96 hours min. before arrival date)

10.       Arrival and departure Excel format crew list (attached example of filling in)(pls do not change the formats and fill in all columns highlighted in blue

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

12.       Crew and passenger list nationality breakdown in PDF format duly signed & stamped

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

20.       Copy of the Register Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

22.       Copy of the International Tonnage Certificate (ITC)

23.       Copy of the Inventory of Hazardous Materials (IHM) Certificate (required by EU Decree 1257/2013 for sea-going ships of more than 500 GT)

24.       Last PARIS MOU inspection (date and port)

25.       Ballast record book scan copy (including last deballast/ballast, place and date in it)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

27.       Maritime Declaration of Health (attached form of filling in) 

28.       Mosquitos Report (attached form of filling in)

29.       Vessels contact numbers (Cell, Inmarsat, Fax, etc..)

 

 

CREW:            Passport copies and full flight itineraries for all on-signing and/or off-signing crew for immigration purposes to make the arrangements needed.

Only Exit visas for off-signing crew can be arranged, documents need to be received at least 72 working hours in advance, from Monday to Friday, from 09:00-13:00 (visas will not be issued after this time)

Visas requested on Thursday / Friday will be appointed for the following week. 

Documents needed for the exit visa are Passport copy, Seaman’s book copy and Flight ticket with valid locator along with the Schengen Form attached filled up by the crew member.

                       Please find attached the crew movements instructions sheet will all relevant information concerning crew. Please, contact our Crew Dpt: crewlpa@canarship.com <mailto:crewlpa@canarship.com>

Good day SEABOURN SOJOURN Staff, 

 

We are looking forward to attending your good vessel during your call at Santa Cruz de Tenerife Port next 24TH March 2025 (08:00-23:00LT)

Berth assigned for this Port Call will be the same as last 12th March: Muelle Sur, 2nd alignment

 

These are the pre-arrival docs and info required by local Authorities that we need 96 hours before your arrival, of course the sooner the better:

 

1.          ETA Santa Cruz de Tenerife (regular updates requested, including 96, 48, 24, 12 hrs)

2.          ETD Santa Cruz de Tenerife

3.          Planned OPS at Tenerife: (scope of works if any)

4.          Drafts upon arrival

5.          Last port of call before Santa Cruz de Tenerife 

6.          Next port of call after Santa Cruz de Tenerife

7.          Itinerary which must includes ports, dates , ETA and ETD.

8.          Arrival and departure IMO Crew List in PDF format duly signed & stamped ( to be sent 96 hous min. before arrival date)

9.          Arrival and departure IMO Passengers List in PDF format duly signed and stamped ( to be sent 96 hours min. before arrival date)

10.       Arrival and departure Excel format crew list (attached example of filling in)(pls do not change the formats and fill in all columns highlighted in blue

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

12.       Crew and passenger list nationality breakdown in PDF format duly signed & stamped

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

20.       Copy of the Register Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

22.       Copy of the International Tonnage Certificate (ITC)

23.       Copy of the Inventory of Hazardous Materials (IHM) Certificate (required by EU Decree 1257/2013 for sea-going ships of more than 500 GT)

24.       Last PARIS MOU inspection (date and port)

25.       Ballast record book scan copy (including last deballast/ballast, place and date in it)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

27.       Maritime Declaration of Health (attached form of filling in) 

28.       Mosquitos Report (attached form of filling in)

29.       Vessels contact numbers (Cell, Inmarsat, Fax, etc..)

 

 

CREW:            Passport copies and full flight itineraries for all on-signing and/or off-signing crew for immigration purposes to make the arrangements needed.

Only Exit visas for off-signing crew can be arranged, documents need to be received at least 72 working hours in advance, from Monday to Friday, from 09:00-13:00 (visas will not be issued after this time)

Visas requested on Thursday / Friday will be appointed for the following week. 

Documents needed for the exit visa are Passport copy, Seaman’s book copy and Flight ticket with valid locator along with the Schengen Form attached filled up by the crew member.

Good day SEABOURN SOJOURN Staff, 

 

We are looking forward to attending your good vessel during your call at Santa Cruz de Tenerife Port next 24TH March 2025 (08:00-23:00LT)

Berth assigned for this Port Call will be the same as last 12th March: Muelle Sur, 2nd alignment

 

These are the pre-arrival docs and info required by local Authorities that we need 96 hours before your arrival, of course the sooner the better:

 

1.          ETA Santa Cruz de Tenerife (regular updates requested, including 96, 48, 24, 12 hrs)

2.          ETD Santa Cruz de Tenerife

3.          Planned OPS at Tenerife: (scope of works if any)

4.          Drafts upon arrival

5.          Last port of call before Santa Cruz de Tenerife 

6.          Next port of call after Santa Cruz de Tenerife

7.          Itinerary which must includes ports, dates , ETA and ETD.

8.          Arrival and departure IMO Crew List in PDF format duly signed & stamped ( to be sent 96 hous min. before arrival date)

9.          Arrival and departure IMO Passengers List in PDF format duly signed and stamped ( to be sent 96 hours min. before arrival date)

10.       Arrival and departure Excel format crew list (attached example of filling in)(pls do not change the formats and fill in all columns highlighted in blue

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

12.       Crew and passenger list nationality breakdown in PDF format duly signed & stamped

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

20.       Copy of the Register Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

22.       Copy of the International Tonnage Certificate (ITC)

23.       Copy of the Inventory of Hazardous Materials (IHM) Certificate (required by EU Decree 1257/2013 for sea-going ships of more than 500 GT)

24.       Last PARIS MOU inspection (date and port)

25.       Ballast record book scan copy (including last deballast/ballast, place and date in it)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

27.       Maritime Declaration of Health (attached form of filling in) 

28.       Mosquitos Report (attached form of filling in)

29.       Vessels contact numbers (Cell, Inmarsat, Fax, etc..)

 

 

CREW:            Passport copies and full flight itineraries for all on-signing and/or off-signing crew for immigration purposes to make the arrangements needed.

Only Exit visas for off-signing crew can be arranged, documents need to be received at least 72 working hours in advance, from Monday to Friday, from 09:00-13:00 (visas will not be issued after this time)

Visas requested on Thursday / Friday will be appointed for the following week. 

Documents needed for the exit visa are Passport copy, Seaman’s book copy and Flight ticket with valid locator along with the Schengen Form attached filled up by the crew member.

                       Please find attached the crew movements instructions sheet will all relevant information concerning crew. Please, contact our Crew Dpt: crewlpa@canarship.com <mailto:crewlpa@canarship.com> 

 

Please take note that for any crew/guest need (transfers, taxis, shuttle bus, meet & greet, accommodations, special assistance) you must contact our CREW DPT (crewlpa@canarship.com <mailto:crewlpa@canarship.com>   (+34 680846413 (duty phone 24/7) + operationstnf@canarship.com <mailto:operationstnf@canarship.com>  in copy

 

Do not hesitate to contact us for any need.

 

Many thanks to confirm safe receipt of this email.

 

 

Saludos/ Best Regards
